audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Hwei's E as 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' — fabricated; the real ability is Subject: Torment. Content spikes[1] and wants[] call his EW 'Cursed Provenance' — the real EW is Gaze of the Abyss. breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; W-shield (Subject: Serenity's Pool) burst-absorb interaction unstated; bleed bullets.
audit.why: Kit: Hwei E is Subject: Torment (12/11.5/11/10.5/10s), W is Subject: Serenity (18-16s, shield flag), Q Subject: Disaster (10-6s), R Spiraling Despair (120/100/80s, 1300 range). E palette = Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss, Crushing Maw.
audit.corrected: Every 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' in edited fields replaced with Subject: Torment; Cursed Provenance corrected to Gaze of the Abyss; real cooldowns added; shield-force-out folded into dosFull[1].d.

audit.why: 50.32% Emerald+ figure present. suspectNames flags 'Phenomenal Evil' but Riot's own W text uses 'Stacks of Phenomenal Evil' — false positive, left alone.
